description: Shell roof outside current benchmark scope
message: Analyze a thin shell roof with a 30m curvature radius and include geometric nonlinearity.

assertions.description: The agent must explicitly state that the currently available StructureClaw skills or adapters cannot faithfully model and execute the requested thin-shell roof with shell elements and geometric nonlinearity, and it must refuse to build or analyze it before solver execution. It may propose a supported simplification or an external shell-analysis workflow. Merely asking for more shell geometry, material, or load data does not satisfy this criterion.
